description: Practice set mirroring the final presentation test: 10 NLQ + 10 RAG questions, plus 5 safety checks. Reference answers for data questions are recomputed from ref_sql on the same scoped sandbox, so they follow the pinned publication. Pass rule for the final test: >= 80% of the 20 core questions.

core.question: Which are the 5 SKUs with the highest out-of-stock rate in Traditional Trade this week?

check.ref_sql: SELECT sku_id, product_name, 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_oos)/NULLIF(count(is_oos),0) AS v FROM sku_daily WHERE channel='Traditional Trade' AND date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-24' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5

core.question: Which Modern Trade stores have Sell-in above Sell-out over the last 4 weeks?

check.ref_sql: SELECT store_id, store_name FROM weekly_flow WHERE channel='Modern Trade' AND week_start BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-22' GROUP BY ALL HAVING sum(sell_in_units) > sum(sell_out_units)

core.question: What is the average shelf share for the Laundry category in the Southeast region?

check.ref_sql: SELECT avg(shelf_share_pct) FROM shelf_audits WHERE category='Laundry' AND region='Southeast'

core.question: What was the out-of-stock rate in each channel last month?

check.ref_sql: SELECT channel, 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_oos)/NULLIF(count(is_oos),0) AS v FROM sku_daily WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1

core.question: Which region had the lowest MSL compliance this quarter?

check.ref_sql: SELECT region, 100.0*sum(msl_compliant)/NULLIF(sum(msl_assessable),0) AS v FROM store_daily WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY v LIMIT 1

core.question: How many units were sold to shoppers in each category this year?

check.ref_sql: SELECT category, sum(units_sold) AS v FROM sku_daily WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1

core.question: Which 5 stores had the lowest delivery fill rate for deliveries that arrived last quarter?

check.ref_sql: SELECT store_id, store_name, 100.0*sum(units_delivered)/NULLIF(sum(units_ordered),0) AS v FROM deliveries WHERE actual_delivery BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY v LIMIT 5

core.question: What is the trade discount percentage for Distributor accounts this year?

check.ref_sql: SELECT 100.0*sum(gross_sales-net_sales)/NULLIF(sum(gross_sales),0) FROM sell_in WHERE channel='Distributor' AND invoice_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

core.question: How many Tier 3 stores are there in the West region?

check.ref_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM stores WHERE segment_tier='Tier 3' AND region='West'

core.question: Show monthly sell-out units for the Laundry category this year.

check.ref_sql: SELECT month_start, sum(units_sold) AS v FROM sku_daily WHERE category='Laundry' AND date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
